meta.description: Verified solid-gold engagement-ring listings. FIELD POLICY: price/karat/weight values are filled ONLY from the official retailer page named in the row's source fields, with an exact evidence quote. Rows whose price or karat could not be confirmed by direct fetch of the official page have that value set to null and verification 'unverified' — they appear on the Flagged for Review page. Weight in grams: NO retailer reviewed publishes metal weight on its listing pages; the column is therefore blank everywhere and flagged.
meta.no_hallucination_policy: No price, karat, weight, or policy value in this file may be inferred, estimated, or copied from third parties. null means 'not verified — left blank on purpose'.
meta.prices_are: snapshot as of fetched_utc; retail prices change — always re-check the live product page before buying
